relations.evidence: Studied philosophy at St.Petersburg and became interested in Buddhism.

relations.subject: Kārlis Augusts Tennisons
relations.evidence: From 1906 he was active in the Buddhist temple of St.Petersburg, in 1920-23 its director.

relations.subject: Friedrich V. Lustig
relations.evidence: His pupil was Friedrich V. Lustig (1912–1989), whith whom he moved in 1930 to Bangkok.
